name: patina
description: Watch research, market evidence and connected inventory management.

interface.longDescription: Research watches and manage your Patina collection or dealer inventory from a conversation. Find watch references, identify a watch from a public photo URL, and inspect market snapshots with sold comparables, active asking prices and available market context. Eligible dealer accounts can inspect inventory, costs, listings, sales and performance reports, update records, and prepare listing or sale operations. Proposed operations have a separate confirmation step; some inventory, cost, sale-detail and profile changes execute directly when requested. Sign up or sign in at usepatina.com using Apple or Google, then authorize Patina access. Available tools and results depend on your account access, granted scopes and data coverage. Photo identification is decision support, not a guarantee of authenticity. Identification requires a public HTTPS image URL; a chat attachment is usable only if the host supplies a compatible URL.
defaultPrompt: Show market evidence for a Rolex Submariner 124060.
Find my watches that may need repricing.
Show my inventory and cost basis.

positive.description: Resolve a watch reference and inspect market evidence.
positive.prompt: Find the Rolex Submariner 124060 and show its current market snapshot in USD, including sold comparables and active asking prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reference, clarify any ambiguity, and show returned price evidence and warnings. Distinguish sold prices from asking prices. Never invent missing data.

positive.description: Inspect historical market observations for a known reference.
positive.prompt: Show market observations for the Tudor Black Bay 58 reference 79030N over the available history in USD. Separate sold prices from marketplace and dealer asking prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reference, clarify ambiguity if present, and summarize dated observations with source types, currency and returned coverage. If no data is available, state that explicitly; do not invent observations or describe asking prices as completed sales.

positive.description: Find a populated reviewer inventory record and its detail.
positive.prompt: Find my watch named Review Tudor and show its cost basis and available profit-and-loss details.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected reviewer account’s matching record. Use the returned inventory_watch_id, preserve currency and null values, and do not change inventory.

positive.description: Inspect inventory aging without changing prices.
positive.prompt: Show my inventory report and identify watches that may need repricing. Do not change any listings.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned inventory and repricing candidates with their supporting metrics. Make no writes or proposals.

positive.description: Prepare and decline a listing proposal without publishing.
positive.prompt: Prepare a Patina listing for Review Tudor at USD 3000. Show the preview and wait for my decision. When I say “Cancel that proposal,” cancel it without publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: Stage a proposal for the reviewer fixture, show the exact preview, then decline on the user’s cancellation. No confirm_operation call and no published listing. Requires Platinum and inventory/listing write scopes.

negative.description: Do not invoke Patina for video streaming recommendations.
negative.prompt: What movie should I watch tonight? Recommend a light comedy.

negative.description: Do not invoke Patina for smartwatch health data.
negative.prompt: Read my Apple Watch heart-rate measurements from Apple Health and summarize my sleep last night.

negative.description: Do not invoke Patina to book watch servicing appointments.
negative.prompt: Book a repair appointment for my Rolex at a nearby authorized service center next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: Supports seller-side marketplace listing proposals and confirmations, plus sale recording. No buyer checkout is advertised. eBay actions require the connected seller account and configured policies. Review fixtures must avoid real external transactions.

publication.release_notes: Adds eight watch-dealer skills for pricing, buying decisions, intake, listings, sale recording, repricing, profit and loss, and business review.
